limitations: Eight matrix executions are four platform targets over push and PR events, not eight distinct platforms.
The twelve non-Windows skips are preserved by name in every job receipt; they are not passes.
Hosted native Codex parses synthetic source registration and the SDK executes the parsed command twice. installedEntry is false; the package gate independently exercises actual installed MCP.
No model-driven Codex-agent invocation or actual ChatGPT consent/discovery/read is established. Model calls remain zero.
The installed metadata report proves eight declared scenario groups and cleanup, not installed cancellation/I/O fault injection. Those injections remain direct-service evidence.
Existing configuration telemetry instrumentation is separate and does not supply new metadata network instrumentation or an OS sandbox.
This is implementation-head hosted evidence. Final documentation, merge/main and recovery observations require their own identities and times.
The combined-status wrapper returned no legacy statuses; complete Actions and check-run APIs independently yielded all three runs and all nine checks.
auditParserObservation: The initial local log-audit parser counted only unindented spec output and did not normalize Windows CRLF for matching. Its count assertion failed before writing a result. The parser was corrected to include the eight nested subtests and normalize only the analysis string; all retained raw/decoded log bytes are unchanged. This was an observation-parser correction, not a product test failure or rerun.
